text: Merged #6547 (BINDEVENT nFlags bit-0 inverted; PR #6564, 2 review rounds -- round 2 caught a 4th dispatch site: property-write via SETPEM), #6557 (bare USE target evaluated as expression; PR #6570, 2 review rounds -- round 2 caught bracket-literal and spaced-parenthesized-expression regressions), #6559 (flaky polyglot sidecar CI; PR #6571, 2 review rounds -- round 2 caught the outer ctest timeout and the .NET benchmark's own startup-budget gate both needing the same widening). Docs/81 cluster 1 (reentrant-cursor-closure) confirmed fully closed. Moving to cluster 27 ([Architecture] proposals, read-only survey) next per the recommended order, then likely cluster 4/13 (DBF/DBC byte-format, warm context from #6047).
